verdict.rationale: Vanta documents dedicated HIPAA (Security and Breach Notification Rules) and GDPR (privacy workflows, continuous monitoring) offerings, plus a PCI page about reusing controls across new frameworks. Its homepage claims 35+ frameworks on one platform, with controls cross-mapped across pre-built frameworks and API filtering by framework. A community report that pricing scales with the number of frameworks indirectly confirms multiple frameworks are run in the same product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of HIPAA/GDPR/PCI depth, and detailed PCI DSS-specific documentation (the PCI evidence is thin marketing copy).
